factProposals.value: Code enforcement permit applications are reviewed by staff and approved or rejected; the decision is reflected in the permit status.
Code enforcement officers review permits on the /permits page.
Approving or rejecting a permit is a staff decision; before an approval the reviewer confirms that the code section was verified and the site inspected.

decisions.statement: Every permit action is written to the audit trail.
Compliance checks before approval: code section verified and site inspected.
decisions.rationale: working assumptions until the City confirms its rules

limitations.statement: Code enforcement is the only permit type, so REQ-007 is only partly met.
The compliance checks are working assumptions for the City to confirm.
